hash_algorithm.name: sha256
hash_algorithm.json_separators: Python default separators: comma followed by space, colon followed by space
hash_algorithm.definition: content = {k: problem[k] for k in ["title", "statement", "criterions", "reference_solution"]}; digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(content, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
